audit_items.proof_trace: Invalid receipt type bytes are silently accepted without validation. Line 43 casts any byte to TxType enum without checking if the value is defined (valid: 0,1,2,3,4,0x7E). No RlpException is thrown, so peer is not disconnected via the exception handler path.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker sends P2P ReceiptsMessage with invalid type byte 0x99. Decoder accepts it, creating TxReceipt with undefined TxType enum value. Receipt passes validation and may be stored/processed with undefined type, violating EIP-2718 type safety.
